numbering: Sessions numbered 1-26 in broadcast order; the film sits between sessions 22 and 23 and has no episode number.

arcs.name: Assembling the Crew
arcs.summary: Standalone bounty hunts introduce Spike and Jet aboard the Bebop as stragglers start joining their ship.
events: Spike and Jet chase bounties across the solar system, usually ending up broke.
A data dog, Ein, ends up with the crew after a botched bounty.
The con artist Faye Valentine crosses paths with the crew and attaches herself to the Bebop.

arcs.name: Ballad of Fallen Angels
arcs.summary: Spike's past with the Red Dragon Syndicate surfaces for the first time.
events: Spike walks into a trap set by his former partner Vicious and survives a fall through a cathedral window.
Spike's memories of Julia are first hinted at.

arcs.name: On the Road (standalone sessions)
arcs.summary: Mostly self-contained bounty episodes, during which the crew gains its final member.
events: The genius hacker Radical Ed joins the crew after the hunt for an AI hacker.
Jet's past in Ganymede resurfaces when he meets his ex-girlfriend Alisa.

arcs.name: Jupiter Jazz
arcs.summary: A two-parter on Callisto pulls Spike back toward Julia and Vicious.
events: Faye leaves with the crew's money, and Spike follows a lead on Julia to Callisto.
Vicious's attempted coup against the Red Dragon elders is set in motion.
Spike and Vicious clash, and Gren's story ends in tragedy.

arcs.name: Pasts Catching Up (mostly standalone)
arcs.summary: Standalone adventures continue, but several episodes dig into the crew's personal histories.
events: Faye's past as a woman frozen in cryosleep for decades is revealed.
Jet confronts the truth behind the betrayal that cost him his arm.
Faye receives a videotape from her younger self, recorded long before.

arcs.name: Knockin' on Heaven's Door
arcs.summary: The crew chases a record bounty after a bioterror attack on Mars, in a story set between sessions 22 and 23.
events: A mysterious man, Vincent, releases a deadly nanomachine pathogen on Mars.
Spike, Faye, Jet and Ed race to stop a larger attack during Halloween.

arcs.name: The Crew Drifts Apart
arcs.summary: Late-season episodes begin breaking up the family the Bebop had become.
events: Faye finally tracks down her childhood home, but finds it gone.
Ed leaves the Bebop to follow her father, and Ein goes with her.

arcs.name: The Real Folk Blues
arcs.summary: The two-part finale as Spike's Syndicate past comes to collect.
events: Vicious seizes control of the Red Dragon Syndicate and hunts Spike's old associates.
Spike reunites with Julia, who is killed soon after.
Spike storms the Syndicate headquarters, kills Vicious, and collapses after the fight.

filler.note: Anime original, so there's no filler.
